title: Anthropic IPO Valuation Under Pressure After Tech Rout
summary: The steep fall in AI and chip stocks after the midterms is weighing on Anthropic's planned IPO, with prospective buyers now discussing a valuation of about $1.2–1.3 trillion, below the roughly $1.5 trillion many had expected. Bloomberg Intelligence's Mandeep Singh explains how the tech rout and the threat of tougher oversight of data centers are reshaping the deal. The listing could still happen before Thanksgiving, possibly starting smaller and raising its targets if investor demand proves strong.
focus: Shadow Mandeep Singh's explanation of why the valuation range has slipped, then the short exchange on IPO timing and how the deal might be sized.
